identity: VU Dutch full-time Science, Business & Innovation BSc, CROHO 50670, annual basis 2026–2027.
curriculum: The 2026–2027 OER and current Bachelor Study Guide support a Dutch-taught, full-time 180 EC programme. The annual framework shows 60 compulsory EC in each of the first two years, 30 compulsory EC in year three including the 24 EC project, and 30 EC approved electives. Energy and health are application domains within the same degree. Article 11.3 controls the Organic & Sustainable Chemistry title and the wetenschapsfilosofie title. Safety, language assessment and tutoring are integrated or zero-credit, and do not increase the total.
progression: Article 9.1 requires passing Research Design and Methodology before the Bachelorproject and at most 18 EC of other units outstanding. The exact X_430509 module describes an individual external project with a host supervisor, academic guidance, an empirical report and a presentation. Modelling still names X_420227, which Article 15.2 explicitly incorporated into the current applied informatics module XB_0186. Passing the energy project requires Dutch language clearance; passing the physics laboratory requires the fire instruction and safety test. Course-specific attendance rules apply. Approved elective packages require at least 12 EC at level 300 and at most 6 at level 100; recognized minors have the stated approval exceptions. First-year positive advice requires 42 EC.
